description: Daily units sold for the top 20 at-risk items (At Risk Rank <= 20), trailing over the dataset's covered date range. Deliberately NOT zero-based: this dataset's daily totals vary only ~9% day to day even scoped to at-risk items, so a zero-based axis (the general default per docs/design-and-dax-references.md) renders as a flat band and hides the real signal. This is a 'zoomed detail trend' read, not a magnitude comparison — the same rationale as a sparkline. No interpolation smoothing.
